# Namencora Systems & Nomenclature Registry
> Canonical registry of deterministic specifications, state primitives, and consensus topologies.

- Website: https://namencora.com
- Entities: 355 architectural specifications & defensive aliases
- Sitemap: https://namencora.com/sitemap.xml

## Divisions
- Division 00: Core Protocols & Zero-Copy Primitives
- Division 01: Storage Engines & State Retention Topologies
- Division 02: Cognitive, Ontological & Knowledge Normalization Systems
- Division 03: Systems Governance, Circuit Breakers & Consensus
- Division 04: Execution Runtime, Interface Boundaries & Gateways
- Division 05: Distributed Execution Pipelines & Streaming Runtimes
